title: Scoped negative result: one-touch rank-2 retiming misses 5% gate
body:
## Result

This adds a source-pinned, bounded negative result for the one-touch rank-2 retiming family in the selected PR1094 gauge44 local program. **No construction, physical supplier, new κ, or selected-result change is claimed.**

The selected event stream contains 690 same-column consecutive rank-1 climb pairs per direction with exactly one intervening scalar that reads the column. Forward and backward candidate sets agree. Since candidate pairs can overlap at a climb, at most **674** are simultaneously usable. Greedy path matching and a separate dynamic program certify this maximum.

Even granting every retiming, scalar/frame change, copy, hosting, precision, interface and dirty-state restoration for free, the maximum fused profile `{1:1064, 2:1092, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8}` has an exact ceiling bracket `[0.001768911117731, 0.001768911117732]`. The 5% target is `0.00177455681454345`; at least **720** zero-overhead fusions are required (719 fails, 720 passes). The complete one-touch family therefore misses the gate before physical synthesis.

This closes only this source-pinned one-touch candidate family under the unchanged coverage law. Pairs with more intervening operations, other block ranks, changed words, changed coverage, and other helper inventories remain open.

## Package and verification

Package: `research/complex-rank2-retiming-seed73506/`.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank2-retiming-seed73506 --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank2-retiming-seed73506
```

Both commands passed locally. The second prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`. Inputs include the exact selected-record pin, selected source manifest, review, replay archive/member hashes, and the pinned exact ceiling engine. The selected cold replay was not rerun because this package does not change or claim that construction.

## Predecessors and coordination

This result combines the chronological candidate domain with a disjoint-fusion bound that prior work did not establish. It complements Arham Tahir's [PR1605](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1605) integer block budget, Josie Elliston's [rank-2 fusion threshold finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1596#discussioncomment-18915212), and Navinor's [source event count](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1659#discussioncomment-18916048). PR1671/Discussion 1659 fixes the paid profile; active Discussion 1674 fixes scalar order. This package changes both the scalar schedule and paid rank profile, but does not claim to realize a physical rewrite.
